pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to mismatched data, delaying revenue collection.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: The client wants a fixed-fee engagement with milestone payments rather than time and materials.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Strong preference for fixed-fee with milestone payments over T&M.

desired_state.statement: Reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) to the industry standard of about five days.
desired_state.source_excerpt: days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard

success_criteria.statement: The project must pay for itself by reducing the need for future headcount hires.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: pays for itself in headcount we don't have to hire next year.

risks_unknowns.statement: The CFO is skeptical of consulting vendors and will pull funding if Q3 milestones aren't met.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Otherwise the funding gets pulled into other projects.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers must act as the integration layer between three disconnected systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: it's three systems for one assignment, and the dispatcher is the integration layer.

pain_points.statement: The driver mobile app lacks essential features like photo uploads and messaging.
pain_points.source_excerpt: They can't take photos, they can't flag issues, they can't message the dispatcher.

desired_state.statement: The technical approach for updating the Routemaster dispatch tool.
desired_state.source_excerpt: make the case for incremental change instead of a full rebuild.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Sarah (VP Ops) wants incremental change to meet the 6-month timeline, while Marcus (CTO) has been pushing for a full rebuild.

success_criteria.statement: The technical solution should avoid creating additional compliance work for the upcoming ELD mandate.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: avoid creating new compliance work for him, that's a quiet point in your favor.

risks_unknowns.statement: The company is currently evaluating Transportation Management System (TMS) vendors but hasn't made a selection.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Currently evaluating vendors. No selection made.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend hours on the phone because the driver app is inadequate.
pain_points.source_excerpt: spend two to three hours a day on the phone with drivers

pain_points.statement: Invoice reconciliation requires manual detective work due to mismatched data across systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is doing detective work on every single invoice.

desired_state.statement: Prioritize fixing the invoicing reconciliation first, followed by the dispatcher workflow.
desired_state.source_excerpt: invoicing is the bleeding wound. We need to fix that first.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce the average dispatch time per load from twelve minutes to eight minutes.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we can get that to eight minutes

success_criteria.statement: Have a measurable pilot in production by the end of Q3.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: have something measurable in production by end of September.

risks_unknowns.statement: There is an upcoming federal ELD compliance mandate deadline in November.

pain_points.statement: Technical integration from recent acquisitions of smaller brokerages remains incomplete.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: The VP of Operations needs a consulting partner to help advocate for incremental improvements internally.
desired_state.source_excerpt: need a partner who can help me make the case for incremental change

success_criteria.statement: Secure CFO and CTO approval by tying technical approach to milestone payments and dollar metrics.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Rita will want to see the milestone payments and the success metrics tied to dollars.

risks_unknowns.statement: The engagement is highly competitive, with the client actively evaluating two other consulting firms.
